items.title: Where Your Agent Leaks Tokens, The MCP Token Tax
items.summary: Your agent’s actual request is about 1.6% of the tokens it sends. The rest is tool schemas, history, and raw results re-read on every turn. In this presentation, I walk through four token leaks in MCP-based agents (catalog, payloads, cache misses, blind spots), demo the same prompt in three tool modes with live token counts, and share what to measure first.
